extension.description: Lua debugger (DAP) and language server (LSP) for VS Code, powered by standalone Go servers.
debugger.label: Lua DevTools
launch.program: Absolute path of the Lua script to debug.
launch.args: Command-line arguments passed to the script.
launch.cwd: Working directory for the script; defaults to the script's directory.
launch.luaPath: Lua interpreter path. When empty, lua5.4, Homebrew lua@5.4 and lua are tried in order.
launch.stopOnEntry: Pause on the first line of the script.
snippet.label: Lua DevTools: Launch
snippet.description: Launch the current file with Lua DevTools
config.luaPath: Lua interpreter for debugging, syntax checking and standard-library completion. When empty, lua5.4, Homebrew lua@5.4 and lua are tried in order.
config.trace.server: Traces the JSON-RPC communication between VS Code and the Lua language server (Output panel).
launch.packagePath: Extra Lua module search patterns added to LUA_PATH before the interpreter defaults, e.g. "${workspaceFolder}/src/?.lua".
launch.packageCPath: Extra C module search patterns added to LUA_CPATH before the interpreter defaults, e.g. "${workspaceFolder}/lib/?.so".
launch.env: Environment variables for the Lua process.
view.environments.trust:
Trust this workspace to discover Lua interpreters.
[Manage Workspace Trust](command:workbench.trust.manage)
config.luarocksPath: LuaRocks executable path or command. When empty, searches PATH for luarocks. Packages are installed into the project for the chosen interpreter.
config.styluaPath: StyLua executable path or command for Lua formatting. Empty uses stylua on PATH. Project stylua.toml settings are respected.
launch.interactive: Keep stdin available to the program; use Send Program Input / Close Program Input. Requires LuaSocket for the separate debug connection.
launch.breakOnCoroutineErrors: Pause on errors caught by coroutine.resume and inspect the failed coroutine before returning to its caller.
attach.host: Host running the Lua debugger bootstrap.
attach.token: Token matching the Lua listener configuration.
attach.label: Lua: Attach to Host
attach.description: Attach to a Lua or embedded host that called lua-devtools.listen.
